title: 河川水位自動遙測
subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection
summary: 本課將自動水位站拆為基準、感測、取樣、傳輸、率定與電源備援，逐一區分準確度、資料時效及可用性。以李斯渡口和維克斯堡真實站點為背景，所有算例是合成資料；觀測水位、推估流量和警戒決策屬不同層次，必須保留各自假設及品質旗標。
summaryEn: This course separates automated gaging into datum, sensing, sampling, transmission, rating and power redundancy, distinguishing accuracy, data age and availability. Lees Ferry and Vicksburg provide real station context, while every calculation uses synthetic observations. Measured stage, estimated discharge and warning decisions occupy different layers and require their own assumptions and quality flags.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」與「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification" and "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測站基準與水面高程」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gage datum and water elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。基準點沉陷、支架位移與換儀器可能使整段資料產生偏移，即使曲線仍然平滑；跨站或與堤頂比較前必須連接相同垂直基準，並保存基準更動日期，避免把儀器零點變化誤認為河川水位突變。本例基準與讀值已用同一垂直系統及公尺表示；沒有處理不同國家高程系統、橢球高或潮位基準間的轉換。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測站基準與水面高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. Benchmark settlement, support movement and instrument replacement can shift an entire record while leaving a smooth curve. Comparing stations or levee crests requires a common vertical datum and documented changes so that instrument offsets are not mistaken for river-level changes. The example uses meters and one vertical system for datum and reading. It does not convert national height systems, ellipsoidal heights or tidal datums. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gage datum and water elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測站基準與水面高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gage datum and water elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。基準點沉陷、支架位移與換儀器可能使整段資料產生偏移，即使曲線仍然平滑；跨站或與堤頂比較前必須連接相同垂直基準，並保存基準更動日期，避免把儀器零點變化誤認為河川水位突變。
knowledge.textEn: A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. Benchmark settlement, support movement and instrument replacement can shift an entire record while leaving a smooth curve.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。
水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。
任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。
optionsEn: Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation.
Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
quiz.explanation: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測站基準與水面高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gage datum and water elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Water-surface elevation Z=z0+h=102.35 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Water-surface elevation Z=z0+h=102.35 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要圖表每秒重畫，就代表河川每秒都有一筆新量測。
裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。
optionsEn: A graph refreshed every second means the river has a new measurement every second.
Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測站基準與水面高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gage datum and water elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。對任何零點改正加上生效日期和版本，並用同時人工讀值確認自動資料沒有未標記跳變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Date and version every datum correction, and compare simultaneous manual observations to ensure that automated data contain no unmarked discontinuity after installation or adjustment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩站建立零點、讀值和水面高程表，讓一站零點改變但實際水面不變。說明資料庫應如何保留原值、改正值及版本，以免形成假洪峰。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build datum, reading and elevation tables for two stations, changing one datum without changing the physical surface. Explain how original values, corrections and versions should be retained to prevent an artificial flood peak.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。對任何零點改正加上生效日期和版本，並用同時人工讀值確認自動資料沒有未標記跳變。
knowledge.textEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Date and version every datum correction, and compare simultaneous manual observations to ensure that automated data contain no unmarked discontinuity after installation or adjustment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為兩站建立零點、讀值和水面高程表，讓一站零點改變但實際水面不變。說明資料庫應如何保留原值、改正值及版本，以免形成假洪峰。
knowledge.textEn: Build datum, reading and elevation tables for two stations, changing one datum without changing the physical surface. Explain how original values, corrections and versions should be retained to prevent an artificial flood peak.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification"?
options: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。
optionsEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter.
quiz.explanation: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測站基準與水面高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gage datum and water elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Overwriting originals with corrections prevents reconstruction of the warning information displayed at the time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例基準與讀值已用同一垂直系統及公尺表示；沒有處理不同國家高程系統、橢球高或潮位基準間的轉換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not convert national height systems, ellipsoidal heights or tidal datums.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Overwriting originals with corrections prevents reconstruction of the warning information displayed at the time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。
任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data.
Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
quiz.explanation: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。水密度受溫鹽影響，感測器位置也可能被淤埋或漂移；因此壓力變化不一定全是水位變化，氣壓補償和安裝高程必須與原始壓力一起保存。本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓並假設靜水、淡水定密度；在高速流或堵塞導壓管附近，動壓與延遲需要另行評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. Absolute sensors require synchronized atmospheric subtraction, while vented sensors rely on a reference vent. Density varies with temperature and salinity, and the sensor can be buried or displaced. Pressure changes therefore need not all represent stage changes; barometric compensation and installation elevation must accompany the raw pressure record. The example uses gauge pressure after atmospheric subtraction and assumes hydrostatic freshwater of fixed density. Dynamic pressure and lag require separate assessment near fast flow or blocked pressure tubing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。水密度受溫鹽影響，感測器位置也可能被淤埋或漂移；因此壓力變化不一定全是水位變化，氣壓補償和安裝高程必須與原始壓力一起保存。
knowledge.textEn: A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. Absolute sensors require synchronized atmospheric subtraction, while vented sensors rely on a reference vent.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。
雷達不接觸水，所以不需要高程測量或現地水尺交叉驗證。
浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。
optionsEn: Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
Noncontact radar needs neither elevation surveying nor field staff-gage checks.
A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth.
quiz.explanation: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Water-column height h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Water-column height h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。
封包剛收到就一定代表此刻水位，無需再看量測時間。
取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
A newly received packet necessarily represents current stage without checking observation time.
Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。檢查通氣管結露、導壓管堵塞與漂移，避免用軟體校正常數掩蓋實際安裝故障。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Inspect vent condensation, pressure-line blockage and displacement so that software correction constants do not conceal physical installation faults or delayed response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同水位下兩種大氣壓的絕對壓力讀值，完成扣除後確認水深不變。再加入氣壓資料延遲情境，說明時間同步和精確感測同樣必要。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare absolute readings at two atmospheric pressures with unchanged water level and confirm invariant depth after subtraction. Then introduce delayed barometric data and explain why synchronization matters alongside sensor precision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。檢查通氣管結露、導壓管堵塞與漂移，避免用軟體校正常數掩蓋實際安裝故障。
knowledge.textEn: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Inspect vent condensation, pressure-line blockage and displacement so that software correction constants do not conceal physical installation faults or delayed response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較相同水位下兩種大氣壓的絕對壓力讀值，完成扣除後確認水深不變。再加入氣壓資料延遲情境，說明時間同步和精確感測同樣必要。
knowledge.textEn: Compare absolute readings at two atmospheric pressures with unchanged water level and confirm invariant depth after subtraction. Then introduce delayed barometric data and explain why synchronization matters alongside sensor precision.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。
電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage.
Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth. A wet vent can produce gradual bias, while sediment burial may delay response and make a flood crest appear lower and later. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓並假設靜水、淡水定密度；在高速流或堵塞導壓管附近，動壓與延遲需要另行評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dynamic pressure and lag require separate assessment near fast flow or blocked pressure tubing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。
knowledge.textEn: Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth. A wet vent can produce gradual bias, while sediment burial may delay response and make a flood crest appear lower and later.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
雷達不接觸水，所以不需要高程測量或現地水尺交叉驗證。
將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Noncontact radar needs neither elevation surveying nor field staff-gage checks.
Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth.
quiz.explanation: 將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
